platform: macOS ARM64; Apple M5 Pro; Chrome ANGLE Metal
method: Four alternating-order rounds; new browser context per page; localhost assets with no-store; shared browser/GPU process. Round zero is first use, subsequent rounds may reuse driver caches. Three.js explicitly waits for GPU completion; Plotly awaits its update promise and another animation frame.
